source: Ken French data library (daily, weekday calendar; FF3, 12 industries VW, 6 ME×Prior BIG HiPRIOR VW)

rule.benchmark: MKT = French Mkt-RF + RF, buy and hold

tax.label: APPROXIMATE Korean tax: core/tax_fx.simulate on index levels (close = adj, no dividends), fixed 1,300 KRW/USD, 2.5M KRW allowance, 22%, no loss carry-forward, fee = cost_bps, no FX spread
tax.after_tax_terminal: pre-tax sleeve-level terminal × (tax_fx tax terminal / index_sim no-tax terminal) of the frame
tax.subsample: tax only on windows starting in months (1, 4, 7, 10) (every 3rd monthly start); pre-tax on all

windows.excluded: windows starting before 1967 and ending after 1966 (bridge)

rule.observed_ir: annualized IR of daily (strategy − market) pre-tax, one continuous account 1967-01..2007-12
